name: After Images
author: TheGrizard
tagline: a generative synth: four layers, one button, endless pieces
description: After Images makes endless ambient pieces: four layers (GROUND, BODY, LIGHT, DUST), each a generative sequencer (eleven, from Euclidean and Markov to Lorenz and Conway's Life) driving one of twenty-five sound engines in its own part of the spectrum. Press REC for a new piece, following on from the last round the circle of fifths. Shimmer, reverse echo, chorus and tape, three visuals, MIDI clock sync, and USB audio with each layer on its own track.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita.
